title: Expense capture
idea: Expense capture: Receipt preview and amount correction lead a review total
audience: People who need to record expense within a mobile surface.
avoidWhen: A decorative camera serves no task
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic transaction layout through its record expense priority and explicit commitment contract: Prevent duplicate submissions and preserve receipt draft
navigation: Expense capture keeps the current record expense context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Receipt preview and amount correction lead a review total
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to record expense; users verify extracted transaction details
composition.priority: Prevent duplicate submissions and preserve receipt draft

imagery.role: Support the actual record expense context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Allow currency and amount edits with keyboard visible
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the expense capture structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no record expense content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Prevent duplicate submissions and preserve receipt draft
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized record expense content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Prevent duplicate submissions and preserve receipt draft
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active record expense context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
